name: @firsthand/contracts
description: FIRSTHAND Solidity contracts (Foundry) with generated TypeScript ABIs and deployment addresses

scripts.test:testnet: if [ -z "$MONAD_RPC_URL" ]; then echo 'contracts test:testnet: MONAD_RPC_URL is unset - skipping the fork tests'; else forge test --match-path 'test/fork/*' $(forge test --help | grep -q -- --odyssey && echo --odyssey) --rpc-url "$MONAD_RPC_URL"; fi
scripts.coverage: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=coverage forge coverage --report lcov --report-file lcov.info --no-match-coverage '(^|/)(test|script)/' && node ../scripts/coverage-gate.mjs --lcov lcov.info --min 100 --min-branches 95 --include src/ && node ../scripts/coverage-gate.mjs --lcov lcov.info --min 95 --include src/libraries/
